**Finding: deviation (medium) — Section 12 (Specifications and Warranty)**

**What the document does well:** the Software conformance warranty runs for one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date and continues while maintenance is in place, which meets our preferred 12-month software position. There is no "AS IS" clause and no disclaimer of implied warranties anywhere in the agreement, so the express warranty is not swallowed; Section 15 limits damage types only.

**Gaps identified:**
1. **No warranty remedy.** Repair exists only as a fee-bearing Maintenance Service (Section 10(c), p0077), and the refund path in Sections 7–8 is confined to the acceptance period. If maintenance lapses, the warranty has no teeth.
2. **No services warranty.** Installation, data conversion, training and maintenance are all performed by Garman with no professional/workmanlike standard.
3. **No malicious code or legal compliance warranties.**

**Redline (validated, preferred level):** a single inserted paragraph in Section 12 adding the professional and workmanlike services warranty, compliance-with-laws and malicious-code warranties, an at-Garman's-option re-performance/repair/replace remedy with a refund backstop if uncured within 30 business days, and a confirmation that the warranty is not displaced by Section 10 maintenance. The comment offers a 90-day services warranty as the fallback.
